integrity: Exact rational example checked independently of the analytic universal proof; no finite test is asserted to establish universally quantified inequalities. No independent scientific audit is available.
scientific_limitations: Two conservatively coupled patches, strictly positive parameters, common local resource terms, exactly matched invader target, and local/equilibrium rather than global dynamical conclusions. A continuum PDE statement and global convergence are not claimed.
title: Resident-pattern mimicry guarantees invasion and excludes positive coexistence in two patches
